title: Magical Hand Crossbow
summary: Unobtainable +2 hand crossbow that grants a close-range melee follow-up on a qualifying hit.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 2 Piercing plus Dexterity. +2 to attack rolls. Martial one-handed ranged weapon, 50 ft range, Light and Dippable.
fields.Cunning Combo: When you hit a nearby enemy with a shot, spend a Reaction to make a melee attack against that enemy. Critical hits do not trigger the reaction. The source gives no exact trigger distance.
fields.Piercing Shot: Action, ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Mobile Shot: After Dash or Disengage on the same turn, make a ranged attack as a Bonus Action within 50 ft. 1d6 + Dexterity Piercing as listed by the action. Once per Short Rest.
fields.Base value: 770 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
